title: Filling of the Spirit
definition: The filling of the Spirit is the believer's ongoing dependence on and yieldedness to the Holy Spirit for worship, obedience, wisdom, courage, and service.
summary: The filling of the Spirit is not spiritual showmanship. It produces worship, thankfulness, holiness, boldness, and Christlike living.
christFocus: The Spirit fills believers so that Christ is honored in their words, character, service, and witness.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: The filling of the Spirit is not spiritual showmanship. It produces worship, thankfulness, holiness, boldness, and Christlike living.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, follow Christ faithfully, and avoid confusion in doctrine and daily life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
